title: MapExtraDef
description:
A map extra definition from JSON type `"map_extra"`.

Defines a special feature that can appear on the overmap (e.g. craters, crashed helicopters, roadblocks, portals).

flags.description: Flags associated with the map extra.

generator.description: Generator configuration for placing this map extra.

mapgen_palette.description: Mapgen palette used by this map extra.

name.description: Display name of the map extra.

LocalizedString.description:
A localized string that may contain translations for multiple languages.

In CDDA JSON, this appears as: ```json { "str": "name", "//~": "context" } { "str_sp": "name" }           // same for singular & plural { "str_pl": "names" }          // explicit plural ``` Or as a plain string `"name"`.

For Stage 1 we store the raw English text. Full i18n support (extracting translations) is deferred.

anyOf.description: A localized object with optional plural and context.
